name: dobe_lean_grip
desc: keep the pink doberman exactly the same: leaning back, head, face, closed eyes, faint smirk, upper body, lower body, drips and goo ropes, and keep the blue pillar exactly the same. Only change its right hand: instead of an open hand floating in the air, the hand firmly grips and clutches the right edge of the blue pillar, fingers wrapped around it and sinking into the goo, so the arm is pulled taut from the shoulder to the gripping hand. Same pink colors and pixel art style.
